gaps.sentence: The problem was ___ (SIMPLE) a matter of bad timing.
gaps.explanation: 'Simply a matter of' = only a matter of.

gaps.sentence: The factory has doubled its ___ (PRODUCE) of electric batteries.
gaps.explanation: 'Its production' — the noun for the amount manufactured follows the possessive.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (INTRODUCE) of the euro changed European trade.
gaps.explanation: 'The introduction of' — the noun for starting something new.

gaps.sentence: The new ___ (GOVERN) takes office in May.
The ___ (ARRIVE) of the delegation was delayed by the storm.
The storm caused ___ (WIDE) damage along the coast.
gaps.explanation: 'Widespread damage' = damage across a large area.

gaps.sentence: They searched the area ___ (SYSTEM) for clues.
The palace is open to ___ (VISIT) all year.
